title: Piano: AI Buddy Digitiamo
summary: Project plan for AI Buddy, an internal assistant answering Digitiamo handbook and Guides questions with source citations; sets architecture, decisions, phases, and KPIs.
notes: Manifest declares SPEC (authoritative). Content is mixed: decision table, architecture, phases, KPIs, risks. Section 2.1 (Milestone 1 decisions, 03/11/2026) overrides section 2 where they conflict: D1a overrides D1, D7a refines D7. Decisions in 2 and 2.1 are treated as locked by the orchestrator instruction, not by ADR status. Output filename lacks the 8-char SHA-256 suffix because the classifier had no hashing tool available; the synthesizer should match on source_path, not filename.
